title: PFL World Tournament: Brand Spot
tagline: A launch film that sold fans on a brand-new tournament format — and the fighters competing in it.

body: The PFL's World Tournament was a format fans had never seen, so the launch film had to teach and sell at the same time — explaining how it worked while making people want to watch. Balancing clarity, hype and storytelling was the whole job.
We also had to introduce fighters from around the world, each with their own story, on a tight four-week turnaround.

The film led with the stakes — win or go home — and put the global roster front and center, so fans had someone to root for before the first bell. Clear calls to action and branding pointed all that hype toward tuning in.

We shot near the fighters' training facility in Florida on a 20-foot LED wall, creating an immersive environment that matched the new on-screen package — so the promo, the broadcast and the campaign all looked like one brand.
led: Built the story around the format's win-or-go-home stakes
Matched the film to the new tournament brand
Delivered under a tight four-week turnaround

impact.note: The client loved it, and fan sentiment online was overwhelmingly positive — praised for making the new format easy to understand and for the cinematic quality of the promo.
